title: Event
description: One point in space and time, or a long process with an interval and usually no place. An event points at a place record rather than repeating its coordinates; region is derived at index time from that place, and on the record it is an optional override, required when place is null.

names.description: What else this event is called: the common name where the title is the formal one, the name in another language, the name a source uses. Optional, unlike an actor's or a place's, because the title is already the display name and this list exists for search — an event nobody calls anything else carries no key at all. Held to a shape by rule 18, as the other two are: no empty list, no name twice, and never the title itself. Search does not fold it yet; that is the search shard's, and plan decision 5.

place.description: The place record this event happened at, or null for a process with no honest point, which is then timeline-only and must carry a region.

regionNote.description: Why the lane on this record is an override rather than the derivation. Written only beside a `region`, and only by whatever set it: the import writes it because a placeless event or a place whose own point reaches no polygon has to be given a lane, and a lane given by a tool is not the same fact as one derived from a coordinate (health review A, finding 23a). A person writing an override says why here too, in a sentence.

actors.description: The actors of this event and what each did in it — not everyone alive. Roles are free text for now; build-index.mjs emits the set in use so a closed vocabulary can be decided later. That every actor resolves is rule 14.
